captions.detailed: A professional DSLR camera flash accessory colored in matte black. It features a tall rectangular main body with a mounting foot at the bottom, and a rear control panel consisting of a small blue-grey display screen surrounded by several raised square buttons. Above the body, a forward-facing rectangular flash head is mounted within a dual-arm yoke, allowing it to pitch forward and backward while the entire head assembly can swivel horizontally.
captions.instruction: Generate a CAD model of a professional camera flash accessory with a tall rectangular body, a mounting foot, a rear-facing control panel with a small screen and buttons, and a forward-facing flash head mounted in a yoke. The head should have a horizontal revolute joint to tilt within the yoke, the yoke should have a vertical revolute joint to swivel relative to the body, and each button on the rear panel should be modeled with a prismatic push joint.
captions.factory: Construct the base body using a Box primitive, adding a flat square foot at the bottom. Create the control panel on the rear surface by combining a thin Box for the screen with multiple smaller Box primitives for the individual buttons. Build the yoke assembly using a vertical cylinder for the swivel neck, topped with a horizontal cross-bar and two vertical side arms. Create the flash head as a forward-projecting Box suspended between the yoke arms. Define a vertical revolute joint between the body and the yoke, a horizontal revolute joint between the yoke and the flash head, and individual prismatic joints for each control button.
